verdict.rationale: Vercel has an official CLI (vercel-gh-1 mentions using it to deploy, vercel-probe-4 confirms dedicated docs page) but the evidence pack doesn't explicitly frame this CLI as AI-native/agent-oriented (e.g., no mention of AI agent workflows, MCP support, or agentic tooling within the CLI itself), even though other AI-agent features exist for the platform generally (vercel-docs-4, vercel-docs-10). missing for 10: explicit documentation tying the CLI to AI-native/agentic workflows, independent hands-on verification of CLI's agent-friendliness.
